== English Virtual Original comparison ==
Early puts a lost character out of play only when lost from table. The later ‘your just lost characters’ removes the source-zone restriction. This matters for cards lost in other ways; the once-per-turn deploy from Lost Pile and immunity to the owner’s Alter remain.
